title: An Interpretable Approach to PDE Solution Discovery via Structural Experience Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12003v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: PDE solution discovery aims to identify explicit symbolic expressions for unknown physical fields from observations under known physical constraints. Existing methods, however, collapse data fidelity and physical consistency into a single terminal score used as the sole feedback signal, providing little information about which subexpressions are responsible for a candidate's final performance. This opaque terminal feedback severely limits the interpretability of the search process itself, offering no insight into why a candidate succeeds or fails. Consequently, reusable structures in otherwise suboptimal candidates are often discarded, whereas incidental syntax along successful search trajectories may be repeatedly reinforced. We propose SED-MCTS, a Monte Carlo tree search approach that distills structural experience from evaluated expressions and reuses it to guide subsequent symbolic solution search. translated_title: 一种通过结构经验蒸馏实现偏微分方程解发现的可解释方法
translated_abstract: PDE（偏微分方程）解发现旨在从已知物理约束下的观测数据中识别未知物理场的显式符号表达式。然而，现有方法将数据保真度与物理一致性合并为单一的最终评分，并将其作为唯一的反馈信号，几乎无法提供关于哪些子表达式决定了候选解最终表现的信息。这种不透明的终端反馈严重限制了搜索过程本身的可解释性，使人们无法了解候选解为何成功或失败。因此，次优候选解中可复用的结构往往被丢弃，而成功搜索轨迹中的偶然语法却可能被反复强化。我们提出了SED-MCTS，这是一种蒙特卡洛树搜索方法，它从被评估的表达式中蒸馏出结构经验，并复用这些经验来指导后续的符号解搜索。通过反事实子树干预……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SED-MCTS，一种基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的方法，通过从已评估表达式中蒸馏并复用结构经验来指导偏微分方程解的符号发现，从而克服了传统单一终端评分反馈导致的可解释性不足问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SED-MCTS, a Monte Carlo tree search approach that distills and reuses structural experience from evaluated expressions to guide PDE solution discovery, overcoming the interpretability limitations of opaque single terminal-score feedback in existing methods.
